title: Account Engagement Needs Activation Targets, Not Link Alone

steps.prompt: A Marketing Cloud Account Engagement team already linked Account Engagement in Data 360 Setup. They expect Data 360 segments to show up as usable audiences in Account Engagement with no further work. Segments remain invisible. What completes the path so those audiences become available downstream?

options.label: Enable automated audience synchronization in Account Engagement connector settings to ingest all active segments
options.rationale: Connecting the orgs does not automatically synchronize segments; audience delivery requires an explicit Activation Target and Segment Activation configuration.

options.label: Configure an Account Engagement Activation Target, then create and schedule Segment Activations for the target audience
options.rationale: Data Cloud requires both an Activation Target (specifying Account Engagement as destination) and individual Segment Activations to push audience memberships downstream.

options.label: Create a Data Action triggered by segment membership changes that writes prospect IDs via Account Engagement REST API
options.rationale: Building custom REST API pipelines using Data Actions introduces unnecessary integration complexity and maintenance overhead when native Activation Targets provide out-of-the-box syncing.
